messages:
noah: FYI found a nasty onboarding flow bug in sample-chat. The error shown to users is misleading.

 tara: what did the API return vs what the SDK showed?

 noah: API returned status=401 with body: ```json
 {
  "status": 401,
  "message": "permission denied",
  "detail": "token expired"
 }
```
 but the Go SDK surfaced ErrForbidden and the web UI told users to request access from an admin. Wrong call to action.

 liam: wow, inconsistent mapping again. We need a canonical map and a small structured payload so SDKs can be deterministic.

 tara: agree. Minimal API contract: status, code (machine string), message (user copy), retry_hint (seconds|null), subcode (optional). Example: 401 + code="unauthorized" + subcode="token_expired".

 noah: that'll let UI show "please re-login" vs "contact admin". Important for first-run users.

 quirk-bot: CI alert: sample-chat smoke failed on go-sdk mapping, see https://ci/7890

 liam: propose mapping table: 401 -> unauthorized, 403 -> forbidden, 404 -> not_found, 429 -> rate_limited, 5xx -> transient_error. SDKs should expose typed exceptions matching code names plus attributes: .code, .retry_after, .is_retryable.

 tara: also request that message be written as a short actionable sentence. Product suggested phrasing: 401 -> "Your API key is invalid or expired. Sign in or create a new key." 403 -> "You don't have access to this resource. Ask your org admin." 429 -> "Too many requests. Try again in X seconds."

 liam: can we implement a contract test on the control plane that returns canonical error fixtures? SDK CI can pull it and assert mapping. That will catch the go-sdk and py-sdk divergences.

 tara: I'll add a small copy table in the docs repo and update the sample app messages to read .code/subcode if present, falling back to message. That will reduce user friction during the rollout.

 noah: timeline: tara & liam will make changes to sample app + sdk tests; devops to expose contract fixtures; I will draft the RFC with examples. Aim to ship small parity patch in 3 business days.

 devops: noted. I can add an API route /_error-fixtures returning the canonical JSON set for CI to consume. Will watch the PRs.

 liam: also add a lint in SDK repos to ensure Error classes include the required attributes. I can open the PR.

 tara: thanks team. Quick interim fix: update sample-chat to display raw status/code when the SDK exception class isn't in {UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError, RateLimitError}.

 quirk-bot: created ticket DX-907 for parity + copy updates.

 noah: sweet. I'll post status in #devex tomorrow. Thanks all :raised_hands:
